description: Trigger: retention/gc_executor.rs implements run_gc_executor() which unpins CIDs, deletes from articles and msgid_map, and writes audit records. retention/gc.rs run_once() duplicates exactly this logic inline. main.rs calls run_once() only; run_gc_executor is never called from production code. Bad behavior: two diverged implementations of the same GC logic means a bug fix in one is not applied to the other. The gc_executor module is dead code in production — either it should be used (and run_once should delegate to it) or it should be removed.
title: gc_executor.rs and gc.rs run_once both perform unpin+delete+audit: dead duplicate code
